is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles funestus s.s. (Abstract, page 1).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study genotypes several markers including GSTe2 L119F, Rdl A296S, Ace-1 N485I, Cyp6p9a/b_R, Cyp9k1 G454A, and structural variants (4.3kb and 6.5kb SV) (page 5, 9).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Figure 5 provides allele frequencies for multiple markers over time. Table 2 provides genotype counts/ORs for L119F-GSTe2 in alive vs dead mosquitoes (page 10).

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected in Mibellon, Cameroon (page 3).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study monitoring insecticide resistance and sporozoite rates over four years (2020-2023) (page 3).

sub_country_location.evidence: The study was conducted in Mibellon, Bankim sub-division, Mayo Banyo Division, Adamawa region, Cameroon (page 3).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study covers a four-year period (2020-2023) with specific collection months provided (page 3).

duplicate_risk.evidence: This is a new, primary longitudinal study (2020-2023) in Mibellon, Cameroon.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data is included in the main text and figures.

assessment.summary: A four-year longitudinal study (2020-2023) in Mibellon, Cameroon, monitoring insecticide resistance and Plasmodium sporozoite infection rates in Anopheles funestus. The study reports high pyrethroid resistance, the fixation of G454A-CYP9K1 and 4.3kb SV markers, and the association of L119F-GSTe2 with survival in bioassays.
